component.name: Carryover
component.summary: Game launcher that syncs your saves through your own cloud storage

description.p: Carryover launches your games and syncs their save folders before and after every play session, so you can continue on another computer or on the Steam Deck. Saves go to your own Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, WebDAV, SFTP or SMB storage; rclone is built in, so nothing else needs installing.

ul.li: One cloud copy per game, mapped to a different save folder on each device
Syncs from the launcher or from Steam: "Add to Steam" creates a shortcut that syncs even in Game Mode
Launches games installed by Heroic Games Launcher in their own Wine prefix
Transfers only the files that changed, and asks which side to keep when saves changed on both
Optional cloud backups, plus a local copy before a download replaces your saves
Save location suggestions for about 21,000 games, including Proton, Wine, Heroic, Lutris and Bottles prefixes
Game list, covers and artwork shared between your devices
